The '''{{PAGENAME}}''', added in [[Update Log|Update 16]], is a reward obtained from reaching Room 100 in the [[Infinity Castle]] (9th Season).

As of 30/09/23, the day of [[Update Log|Update 17]], and the end of Season 9, the Explode Star could be opened to receive [[Bombietta|Bombietta.]]
